item.title: Carl E. “Carlco” Matthews Jr.
item.description: Carl E. “Carlco” Matthews Jr., 81, of Titusville, passed away on Thursday, November 27, 2025, at UPMC Hamot. Carl was born on August 18, 1944, in Franklin to the late Carl Eugene and Mary June Long Matthews. He was a graduate of Franklin High School and Erie School of Business.
